subtopic: Brokers, Investment Advisers, and Financial Planners
source_evidence: These titles are not all the same and do not necessarily mean better service for you.
question: Misconception: If a broker or investment adviser has professional initials after their name, they must be more qualified and offer better service.
answer: Initials alone do not guarantee better service or show that one professional is more qualified than another. Titles differ, and some may limit which products a professional can sell, so ask what the title means and what it allows them to offer.
